record.field: Scheduled actions failing or not running

Active scheduled actions with consecutive failures (Odoo deactivates them after 5 failures over 7 days) and scheduled actions overdue by more than one interval (minimum 1 hour). Three or more overdue actions are reported as a stopped cron worker (critical). Database-wide: reported in the main company.
Emails that could not be sent

Outgoing emails in "failed" state created in the last 24 h. Severity rises when the count reaches the threshold or when invoice emails are affected. Compared with the previous 24 h to detect acceleration. Email addresses and phone numbers are removed from error texts.

Spain Veri*Factu: invoices whose latest record (last 7 days) was rejected or registered with errors by the AEAT (requires l10n_es_edi_verifactu). Electronic invoicing based on account_edi (for example Spain SII): documents blocked by an error, or waiting to be sent for more than 24 h. TicketBAI and FacturaE do not use account_edi and are not covered.

Posted customer invoices unpaid more than "grace days" after their due date, when the outstanding amount reaches the threshold (company currency). Severity rises when the overdue amount grew 20 % or more in 7 days.
Payment transactions that ended in error in the last 24 h, compared with the previous 24 h (requires the payment app).
Outgoing transfers not done whose scheduled date is more than "grace days" in the past, when their number reaches the threshold (requires Inventory).
Product quantities below zero in internal locations (requires Inventory).

Sales orders confirmed the previous day (UTC) compared with the average of the same weekday over the 4 previous weeks. Reported when the drop reaches the threshold (%) and the average is at least 5 orders. Statistical rule: certainty 0.7 (requires Sales).
